g.text: UML domain - personal finance configuration, facts and scoped credentials
contributionFacts : own deposits / SAVE runs / round-ups
streaks : UTC day and month islands
badges : fixed catalogue + first unlock date
One-time secret response is excluded from retained command receipts.
Revocation and expiry are checked at every scoped read.
This token never authorizes a payment or trade.
A held symbol without a retained price at the instant
is reported incomplete; the monthly change is then withheld.
Requests and bill cancellation requests are not money completion.
Actual payments use the existing quoted, approved native payment flow.
